intro: Love's Gift is the penultimate quest in the Horde warlock chain to summon and bind a succubus. After being tracked down and revived in the Barrens, the dying Grunt Dogran relinquishes a treasured keepsake to provide the bait necessary for the dark ritual.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Zankaja is young and beautiful. To be chained to an invalid... I will not allow her to suffer that injustice.
Leave me, friend. And thank you. I may end my life in glorious battle, instead of a lifeless husk.
And please, I would ask you not to tell my mate of this... I do not want guilt on her conscience.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have returned. Are you ready to battle a succubus?

clips.title: Completion
paras: If you tell me that this will suffice, then I trust you, friend. Allow me to clean it though... Pristine and shining, it may be even more enticing to a succubus.
